fields.description: A user holding every pack pays this instead of the sum. Zero means no cap.
fields.label: Operations pack cap per user (monthly)

fields.description: The service code that goes on every subscription line. 997331 is licensing services for the right to use software, which is what a SaaS subscription is. Confirm it with your accountant - it decides the GST rate, and it is one field to change if they disagree.
fields.label: SAC Code

fields.description: How long after the invoice date payment is due.
fields.label: Payment Terms (days)

fields.description: The company that raises the invoice. Left blank, the site default is used.
fields.label: Invoice From

fields.description: Which seed release filled the price list. Its presence is what stops the seed running again over prices someone has since edited.
fields.label: Seeded
